templates.source: Y10 Higher Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S1 Pie charts
templates.text: [[n]] pupils chose their favourite sport. Work out the angle for 1 pupil on a pie chart, and the angle for [[f]] pupils.
templates.answer: [[360 / n]]° for 1 pupil; [[f * 360 / n]]° for [[f]] pupils

templates.source: Y10 Higher Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S1 Pie charts
templates.text: The table shows the favourite sports of [[f1 + f2 + f3 + f4]] pupils. Work out the angle for each sport on a pie chart.
templates.answer: Football [[f1 * 360 / n]]°, rugby [[f2 * 360 / n]]°, tennis [[f3 * 360 / n]]°, hockey [[f4 * 360 / n]]°

templates.source: Y10 Higher Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S1 Pie charts
templates.text: A pie chart is to be drawn for [[n]] pupils. Ben says the angle for [[f]] pupils is [[f * 10]]°. Is he right? Work out the correct angle.
templates.answer: No: 360 ÷ [[n]] = [[360 / n]]° per pupil, so [[f]] pupils is [[f * 360 / n]]°

templates.text: Explain why a histogram uses frequency density instead of frequency, and work out the height of the tallest bar for the table.
templates.answer: Class widths are unequal, so the area of each bar must show the frequency; the tallest bar has frequency density [[max(max(f1 / 10, f2 / 20), max(f3 / 10, f4 / 20))]]

templates.source: Y10 Higher Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S10 Compare distributions using box plots (E)
templates.text: Class A has interquartile range [[q31 - q11]] and class B has [[q32 - q12]]. Which class's results are more consistent?

templates.source: Y10 Higher Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S10 Compare distributions using box plots (E)
templates.text: Compare two box plots: A has median [[md1]], IQR [[q31 - q11]] and range [[mx1 - mn1]]; B has median [[md2]], IQR [[q32 - q12]] and range [[mx2 - mn2]]. Write two comparisons.
templates.answer: The class with the higher median is class [[md1 > md2|if:A/B]]; the class with the smaller IQR (more consistent) is class [[q31 - q11 < q32 - q12|if:A/B]]

templates.source: Y10 Higher Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S10 Compare distributions using box plots (E)
templates.text: Two box plots show test results. A: median [[md1]], IQR [[q31 - q11]]. B: median [[md2]], IQR [[q32 - q12]]. Which class would you say did better and why? Mention an average and a spread. (3 marks)
templates.answer: Compare medians ([[md1]] and [[md2]]) and IQRs ([[q31 - q11]] and [[q32 - q12]]): the higher median shows better typical performance and the smaller IQR shows more consistent results
